sources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare — Introduction to Algorithms readings
Robert Tarjan — Depth-First Search and Linear Graph Algorithms

corrections: Made Dijkstra's nonnegative-edge requirement explicit and labeled O(V) as auxiliary space.
Qualified Bellman-Ford negative-cycle detection as applying to cycles reachable from the source.
Defined Prim's choice as the minimum edge crossing the current cut and removed the inaccurate blanket claim that the heap implementation is best for dense graphs.
Qualified Kruskal as producing a minimum spanning forest on disconnected graphs and separated O(V) auxiliary state from O(E) edge storage.
Corrected Ford-Fulkerson residual updates: forward residual capacity decreases while reverse residual capacity increases.
Corrected the Ford-Fulkerson nontermination qualification from rational capacities to arbitrary real capacities and retained O(E|f*|) only for integer capacities.
Replaced generated prerequisite directions with reviewed mechanism, analogy, and contrast relations.
